answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in haven, verified in marble, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the ripple check. That bill is paid per identity, so 108 aliases cost 286 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
